meta.name: api-design-principles
meta.description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.

copy.tagline: 设计易用可扩展的REST和GraphQL接口
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在设计新API或为团队制定接口标准
copy.tagline_en: Design intuitive, scalable REST and GraphQL APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing new APIs or setting interface standards

howto.what: 这个技能给Claude提供了一套REST和GraphQL的API设计规范。当讨论API时，Claude会按资源导向命名、HTTP方法语义、分页、错误处理、版本化、Schema优先等原则给出建议；也能辅助设计或审查具体接口方案。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计新API、审查API规范或为团队确立API设计标准时触发；重构现有API、在REST与GraphQL间迁移等场景也会用到。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理的REST API，带上分页和错误处理。
say.note: Claude会给出资源导向的接口清单和示例。

say.text: 审查这个GraphQL schema，看看有没有N+1查询问题。
给一份API设计最佳实践清单，用于团队规范。

howto.what_en: Claude uses REST and GraphQL design principles for API discussions: resource-oriented naming, HTTP methods, pagination, errors, versioning, schema-first. Helps draft and review API specs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to design a new API, review an API specification, or establish API design standards. Also for refactoring or migrating between REST and GraphQL.

say_en.text: Design a REST API for user management with pagination and error handling.
say_en.note: Claude will propose resource-oriented endpoints and examples.

say_en.text: Review this GraphQL schema for N+1 issues.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect the schema and suggest DataLoader usage.

say_en.text: Give us a best-practice checklist for API design standards.
say_en.note: Claude will list REST and GraphQL recommendations.
